You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picosoc-uart-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): fabab660abfa8e45
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback with divider 64 sends 0xa5 but receiver returns 0xe0. Lines 90 and 97 compare recv_divcnt against cfg_divider>>4 (=4) instead of cfg_divider (=64), so data and stop states sample far too early and shift in idle/stop bits. This corrupts recv_pattern/recv_buf_data despite the correct half-bit wait in state 1.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash fabab660abfa8e45 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
